# GitHub Copilot instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md` as the shared project protocol. Load the relevant Agent Skill in `.agents/skills/` for direction, refactoring, UI generation, design QA, investigation or Live Inspector work.

Use the design preset router as a contextual suggestion, not an enforced theme. Preserve brand and product requirements; avoid copying reference layouts. Prefer semantic HTML, keyboard support, visible focus, accessible names, reduced motion and complete UI states. Run `npm run design:qa -- src/ --json` and project checks where applicable. Report evidence and limitations honestly.
